verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official Editor MCP server that lets AI assistants programmatically modify project data, but it explicitly requires 'an open PlayCanvas Editor session' rather than running as an independent, scheduled, or background process — this is closer to AI-assisted live editing than autonomous background automation. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/triggered jobs, headless/background execution without a live editor session, or any autonomous agent loop running unattended.
